packageRules.description: Flux controllers are upgraded by regenerating gotk-components.yaml, never by tag bumps (BOW-772)

prBodyNotes: Do not merge: regenerate gotk-components.yaml with `flux install --export` (flux-system README, "Upgrade Flux").

packageRules.description: OnCall's celery needs RabbitMQ's transient_nonexcl_queues permit; a new release can remove it (BOW-763)
prBodyNotes: Before merging, run `rabbitmqctl list_deprecated_features` on the new version: `transient_nonexcl_queues` must not be `removed`, or oncall-celery crash-loops (BOW-763).
